name: Get Dumped ☆
source: Michi has been living nothing short of a shoujo manga romance with her perfect boyfriend… until he asked for a break up. Lost and confused, Michi asks for one last date. Now she aims to find out the reason he chose to do it and get him back!
translation: 米奇和她完美的男友过着少女漫画般的浪漫生活……直到他提出分手。迷失又困惑的米奇请求最后一次约会。现在她的目标是找出他选择这么做的原因，并让他回来！
